title: Lesson 4.0: Mastery Starter
use: Lesson 4.0 page in the Whop course.

scenes.vo: Lesson four point zero. Mastery Starter.

scenes.sub: Every yield is payment for a risk. Staking pays you to secure a network, lending pays for borrower demand, farms often pay in newly printed tokens. This module teaches you to see what each yield really pays for.

scenes.title: The mastery ladder
scenes.vo: Beginner, Tells base yield from emissions. Practitioner, Compares vaults versus DIY and prices points/airdrops as bets. Master, Builds yield from durable sources: lending, staking, savings rates, tokenized treasuries.
